Specification: This module specifies an abstract version of the Quicksort algorithm over finite nonempty sequences of integers drawn from a constant set Values. The partition step is modeled nondeterministically by choosing any sequence in Partitions(I, p, seq), so the spec abstracts away from any concrete in-place partition implementation while preserving the required ordering relation around the pivot. The specification includes a temporal behavior with initialization, a next-state relation, weak fairness of Next, and a termination property stating that eventually pc = "Done". It also contains a substantial TLAPS proof of partial correctness, proving that every terminating execution yields a sorted permutation of the initial sequence.
IfThenElse: IF U # {} THEN /\ \E I \in U: IF Cardinality(I) = 1 THEN /\ U' = U \ {I} /\ seq' = seq ELSE /\ \E p \in Min(I) .. (Max(I)-1): LET I1 == Min(I)..p IN LET I2 == (p+1)..Max(I) IN \E newseq \in Partitions(I, p, seq): /\ seq' = newseq /\ U' = ((U \ {I}) \cup {I1, I2}) /\ pc' = "a" ELSE /\ pc' = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED << seq, U >>

AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME NEW S, NEW f \in Automorphisms(S), NEW g \in Automorphisms(S)
    PROVE  f ** g \in Automorphisms(S)

ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), NEW t \in PermsOf(s)
    PROVE  /\ t \in Seq(T)
           /\ Len(t) = Len(s)
           /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(s) : \E j \in 1 .. Len(s) : t[i] = s[j]
           /\ \A i \in 1 .. Len(s) : \E j \in 1 .. Len(t) : t[j] = s[i]

ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), NEW t \in PermsOf(s), NEW u \in PermsOf(t)
    PROVE  u \in PermsOf(s)

ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Int, NEW x \in S, \A y \in S : x <= y
    PROVE  x = Min(S)

ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Int, NEW x \in S, \A y \in S : x >= y
    PROVE  x = Max(S)

ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Int, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW x \in S
    PROVE  /\ Min(S) \in S 
           /\ Min(S) <= x

ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW y \in S \ T
      PROVE  P(T \cup {y})

ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Int, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW x \in S
    PROVE  /\ Max(S) \in S
           /\ x <= Max(S)

ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW y \in S \ T
      PROVE  P(T \cup {y})

ASSUME NEW i \in Int, NEW j \in Int, i <= j
    PROVE  i = Min(i .. j) /\ j = Max(i .. j)

ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), NEW I \in SUBSET (1 .. Len(s)),
           NEW p \in I, NEW t \in Partitions(I, p, s)
    PROVE  /\ t \in Seq(T)
           /\ Len(t) = Len(s)
           /\ \A i \in (1 .. Len(s)) \ I : t[i] = s[i]
           /\ \A i \in I : \E j \in I : t[i] = s[j]
           /\ \A i,j \in I : i <= p /\ p < j => t[i] <= t[j]

ASSUME NEW J \in UV' 
                PROVE  \E i,j \in 1 .. Len(seq0') : J = i .. j

ASSUME NEW J \in UV', NEW K \in UV', J # K 
                PROVE  J \cap K = {}

ASSUME NEW II \in UV', NEW JJ \in UV',
                              II # JJ,
                              NEW i \in II, NEW j \in JJ,
                              i < j
                       PROVE  seq'[i] =< seq'[j]

ASSUME Inv,
                      pc = "Done"
               PROVE  /\ seq \in PermsOf(seq0)
                      /\ \A p, q \in 1..Len(seq) : p < q => seq[p] =< seq[q]

ASSUME NEW p \in 1..Len(seq), NEW q \in 1..Len(seq),
                        p < q
                 PROVE  seq[p] =< seq[q]
